decisions.title: Root Spawns; Children Do Not Recurse
decisions.description: Only the root agent gets spawn_agent. Children run with a narrower tool list so a helper cannot take over orchestration or open an unbounded spawn tree. Codex allows nested spawn with a concurrency cap; the chapter keeps the gate visible.
decisions.alternatives: Giving every teammate spawn_agent is closer to the full V2 tool table, but it hides the recursion problem s06 already solved by not letting a child spawn further.

zh.title: 只有 root 能 spawn，孩子不能递归
zh.description: 只有 root 拿到 spawn_agent。孩子用更窄的工具表，避免 helper 接管编排或开出不受控的派生树。Codex 允许嵌套 spawn 并设并发上限；教学版把这道闸留在明处。

decisions.title: The Mailbox Is an In-Process Channel
decisions.description: Each agent has an in-memory inbox with waiters, matching Codex's tokio mpsc Mailbox. Sending queues or delivers to a blocked wait_agent. Session history can persist via rollout; the mailbox itself is not a JSONL file per agent.
decisions.alternatives: File-backed JSONL inboxes are easy to inspect, but they describe a different architecture than codex-rs, which keeps the mailbox in process and persists conversation history on the session rollout.

zh.title: 信箱是进程内通道
zh.description: 每个 Agent 一个带 waiter 的内存收件箱，对应 Codex 的 tokio mpsc Mailbox。发送时入队，或直接交给正阻塞的 wait_agent。会话历史可以走 rollout 落盘；信箱本身不是每个 Agent 一个 JSONL 文件。

decisions.title: send_message Queues; It Does Not Start a Turn
decisions.description: Codex splits queue-only send_message (trigger_turn=false) from followup_task (trigger_turn=true). The chapter keeps send_message as a queue: if the target is blocked on wait_agent the mail is handed over, otherwise it waits in the box. Idle wake-up is a later, separate concern.
decisions.alternatives: Treating every send as 'wake the other agent now' is simpler to demo, but it would burn a model turn for chatter and would not match Multi-Agent V2.

zh.title: send_message 只入队，不开一轮
zh.description: Codex 把只排队的 send_message（trigger_turn=false）和会开一轮的 followup_task（trigger_turn=true）分开。教学版的 send_message 就是排队：对方若正阻塞在 wait_agent 上就直接交付，否则进信箱。空闲唤醒是另一件事。
